type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.A10_nonunique_forbids_collapse
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (h : (resolutionSet σ e).length ≠ 1) : collapseOp σ e = none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.A11_local_noncontradiction

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.A15_monotone_refinement

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.A16_collapse_idempotent
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (v : ClassicalConst) (h : collapseOp σ e = some v) : collapseOp σ (.term (.cst v)) = some v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.A4_not_classical_complex
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (i : IndetConst) (c : ClassicalConst), Term.indt i ≠ Term.cst c

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.A5_distinct_from_classical
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (i : IndetConst) (c : ClassicalConst) : Term.indt i ≠ Term.cst c

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.A6_extended_operators
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ op : ClassicalOp, ∃ extOp : ExtendedOp, extOp = .extended op

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.A7_extension_coincides_classical
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (op : ClassicalOp) (t₁ t₂ : Term) (h₁ : t₁.isClassical = true) (h₂ : t₂.isClassical = true) : (Term.app (.classical op) t₁ t₂).isClassical = true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.A9_unique_resolution_implies_collapse
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (v : ClassicalConst) (h : resolutionSet σ e = [v]) : collapseOp σ e = some v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.Collapse_unique
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (e : Expr) (σ : State) (v₁ v₂ : ClassicalConst) (h₁ : Collapse e σ = some v₁) (h₂ : Collapse e σ = some v₂) : v₁ = v₂

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.IndeterminateExpr.classicalFrag_binOp_iff
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (op : OpSymbol 2) (e₁ e₂ : IndeterminateExpr) : classicalFrag (binOp op e₁ e₂) ↔ classicalFrag e₁ ∧ classicalFrag e₂

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.IndeterminateExpr.depth_const

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : wellFormed indeterminate

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.TIF.adm_empty
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} [Add α] [Sub α] [Mul α] [Div α] [DecidableEq α] [Zero α] (v : Valuation α) : Adm (State.empty) v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.TIF.evalC_add
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (v : Valuation α) (e₁ e₂ : CExpr α) : evalC v (CExpr.add e₁ e₂) = match evalC v e₁, evalC v e₂ with | some a, some b => some (a + b) | _, _ => none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.TIF.evalC_const
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (v : Valuation α) (c : α) : evalC v (CExpr.const c) = some c

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.TIF.evalC_div
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (v : Valuation α) (e₁ e₂ : CExpr α) : evalC v (CExpr.div e₁ e₂) = match evalC v e₁, evalC v e₂ with | some a, some b => if b = 0 then none else some (a / b) | _, _ => none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.TIF.evalC_div_nonzero
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (v : Valuation α) (e₁ e₂ : CExpr α) (a b : α) (h₁ : evalC v e₁ = some a) (h₂ : evalC v e₂ = some b) (hb : b ≠ 0) : evalC v (CExpr.div e₁ e₂) = some (a / b)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.TIF.evalC_eq_eval
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} [Add α] [Sub α] [Mul α] [Div α] [DecidableEq α] [Zero α] (v : Valuation α) (e : CExpr α) : evalC v e = eval v (CExpr.embed e)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.TIF.evalC_mul
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (v : Valuation α) (e₁ e₂ : CExpr α) : evalC v (CExpr.mul e₁ e₂) = match evalC v e₁, evalC v e₂ with | some a, some b => some (a * b) | _, _ => none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.TIF.evalC_sub
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (v : Valuation α) (e₁ e₂ : CExpr α) : evalC v (CExpr.sub e₁ e₂) = match evalC v e₁, evalC v e₂ with | some a, some b => some (a - b) | _, _ => none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.TIF.evalC_var
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (v : Valuation α) (x : String) : evalC v (CExpr.var x) = some (v x)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.TIF.eval_const
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: [Add α] [Sub α] [Mul α] [Div α] [DecidableEq α] [Zero α] (v : Valuation α) (c : α) : eval v (Expr.const c) = some c

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.TIF.eval_indet
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: [Add α] [Sub α] [Mul α] [Div α] [DecidableEq α] [Zero α] (v : Valuation α) (k : IndetClass) : eval v (Expr.indet k) = none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.TIF.eval_var
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: [Add α] [Sub α] [Mul α] [Div α] [DecidableEq α] [Zero α] (v : Valuation α) (x : String) : eval v (Expr.var x) = some (v x)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.classical_stability
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (h : e.isClassical = true) : (stateGuidedRewrite σ e).isClassical = true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.collapse_correctness
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (c : ClassicalConst) (h : collapseOp σ e = some c) : collapseTrigger σ (.constrained e .collapse) = .term (.cst c)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.eval_classical_no_indet
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} [Add α] [Sub α] [Mul α] [Div α] [DecidableEq α] [OfNat α 0] (v : Valuation α) (e : Expr α) (hcl : e.isClassical = true) : (∀ ι : IndetClass, e ≠ Expr.indet ι)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.restricted_confluence
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) : ∀ e : Expr, e.isClassical = true → MultiStepRewrite σ e e

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.wellformedness_preservation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e e' : Expr) (h : MultiStepRewrite σ e e') : e'.depth ≤ e.depth + 1

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.classical_const_stable
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type*} [ClassicalScalar α] [DecidableEq α] (c : α) (σ : State α) (vp : ValPair α) (hadm : isAdmissible vp σ = true) : evalTerm vp (Term.const c) = some c

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.classical_reduction
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (φ : Formula) (h : universallyValid φ) : classicallyValid φ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.classical_term_is_expr
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (t : Term) (h : t.isClassical = true) : ∃ e : Expr, e = .term t

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.collapse_complete
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : State α) (e : Expr α) (c : α) (huniq : UniquelyResolves Σ e c) : Collapse Σ e = some c

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.collapse_uniqueness
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (v₁ v₂ : ClassicalConst) (h₁ : collapseOp σ e = some v₁) (h₂ : collapseOp σ e = some v₂) : v₁ = v₂

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.const_classicalNF
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (c : ClassicalConst) : classicalNF Σ (const c)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.depth_subexpr_le
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (op : ExtendedOp) (l r : Term) : l.depth ≤ (Term.app op l r).depth ∧ r.depth ≤ (Term.app op l r).depth

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.indet_isolation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (φ : Formula) (σ : State) (hφ : ∀ c ∈ σ.constraints, c.sym = .block) : satisfies σ (.atom .top)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.indeterminate_blockedNF
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (hno : ∀ v, ¬classicalFrag v → True) (hblock : ¬∃ v, classicalFrag v ∧ Rewrite1 Σ indeterminate v) : blockedNF Σ indeterminate

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.rewrite1_depth_le
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (e e' : IndeterminateExpr) (hstep : Rewrite1 Σ e e') : e'.depth ≤ e.depth

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.rewrite1_preserves_wf
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (e e' : IndeterminateExpr) (hwf : wellFormed e) (hstep : Rewrite1 Σ e e') : wellFormed e'

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.rewrite1_to_star
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (e e' : IndeterminateExpr) (h : Rewrite1 Σ e e') : RewriteStar Σ e e'

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.rewriteStar_preserves_wf
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (e e' : IndeterminateExpr) (hwf : wellFormed e) (hstar : RewriteStar Σ e e') : wellFormed e'

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.rewriteStar_trans
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (e₁ e₂ e₃ : IndeterminateExpr) (h₁₂ : RewriteStar Σ e₁ e₂) (h₂₃ : RewriteStar Σ e₂ e₃) : RewriteStar Σ e₁ e₃

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.supp_empty_iff_classical
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (e : Expr) : e.indetSupport = [] ↔ e.isClassical = true
